user.title: Connect to Eplucon
user.description: Please enter your API token to connect to Eplucon ({api_tokens_url}).

data_description.scan_interval: How often the Eplucon portal is polled. A longer interval sends fewer requests to the portal.

developer_options.name: Developer tools
developer_options.description: Only needed when working on this integration.

data_description.use_mock_data: Read every value from the mock files bundled with the integration instead of the Eplucon API. No request is sent and the API token is ignored.

web_control.name: Web control (optional)
web_control.description: Change heat pump settings from Home Assistant through the Eplucon portal website, which the official API cannot do. Use the e-mail address and password you log in to the portal with. Leave empty to only read data.

data_description.web_username: Required when a password is entered.
data_description.web_password: Required when an e-mail address is entered.
data_description.web_two_factor: Only when your portal account uses 2-step authentication. A 6-digit code is used once; you'll be asked for a new one if the portal session is ever lost (for example after Home Assistant was off for more than 2 hours). The authenticator key (the text code shown when you set up the authenticator app) lets the integration log in again on its own.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Please check your API token and/or API endpoint.
error.api: Failed to connect to the Eplucon API. Please check the API endpoint and try again or check the logs for more info.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or check the logs for more info.
error.no-devices: No devices found. Ensure you're device is added to your Eplucon account
error.web_credentials_incomplete: Web control needs both the portal e-mail address and the password, or neither.
error.web_auth: The Eplucon portal rejected the e-mail address or password.
error.web_two_factor_required: Your portal account uses 2-step authentication. Enter the current 6-digit code or the authenticator key.
error.web_two_factor_invalid: The Eplucon portal rejected the 2FA code. Enter the current code and try again.
error.web_connect: Could not reach the Eplucon portal website. Try again or check the logs for more info.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Eplucon is allowed.

web_control_auth.title: Eplucon web control can't log in
web_control_auth.description: The Eplucon portal rejected the stored e-mail address or password, so heat pump settings can't be read or changed. Update them under Settings > Devices & services > Eplucon > Configure, in the Web control section.

web_control_two_factor.title: Eplucon web control needs a new 2FA code
web_control_two_factor.description: The portal session for web control has ended and the portal asks for a 2-step authentication code again. Enter the current code (or your authenticator key to avoid this in future) under Settings > Devices & services > Eplucon > Configure, in the Web control section.
